# vcp_vmware_gpu_models (Data Source)

List available VMware Cloud GPU models.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_vmware_gpu_models" "in_location" {
  location_id = 5
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `location_id` (Number) Filter GPU models by location ID.

- `gpu_models` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu_models))
